The '''Rawk compound''' was a property on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] located near the edge of [[The Wilds (Kiffex)|the Wilds]]. [[Droo Rawk|Droo]] and "Bantha" [[Rawk]] were allowed to move into the compound by [[Sheyf]] [[Zharia Vos]] in [[137 ABY]] after they fled from [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] trouble on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. A large palace-like house dominated the compound, that included a kitchen, sleeping quarters, a workshop, and a sick bay. [[Cade Skywalker]], Bantha Rawk's nephew, visited the compound in a desperate bid to get Droo to heal his mortally wounded friend [[Azlyn Rae]].
